glosses: Bordeaux, d’une couleur intermédiaire entre le rouge et le violet.
einen ins leichte Violett übergehenden roten Farbton aufweisend

translations.source_sense_description: einen ins leichte Violett übergehenden roten Farbton aufweisend

glosses: Alternative letter-case form of Burgundy (red wine).
A dark red colour tinged with purple, like that of Burgundy (red) wine.

examples.text: Burgundy is everywhere in fashion right now, thanks to Miu Miu and Saint Laurent, but a makeup item is an easier, more instantly gratifying way to get involved. It’s also extremely flattering on almost everyone. Eye colours just pop against burgundy and garnet.

glosses: Of a deep purple red color like that of Burgundy wine.

examples.text: She and her beige-chemised assistant entered the salonlike fourth-floor showroom and were ushered into a smaller private room with burgundy carpeting that matched Rubylee's J. Tiktiner print dress.
